action: Trace the small ion drive from actual actor specifications to the modular preload plan.
observation: The sampled Lamplighter wayfarer and Vael writ-tender actor shapes select this engine, while the sampled player roster resolves whole-ship bodies without it.
decision: Review the modular engine as a reachable component; do not present it as the starter ship engine based only on a mapping table.
next: Inspect the actual packaged engine and its geometry cost.
evidenceScope: Source and pure preload-plan traces for sampled identities, not an observed ordinary gameplay encounter.
performance: Reachability only; no live cost or FPS measurement.

action: Decompose the actual mechanical mesh into spatially connected components.
observation: Twelve approximately 0.07-unit rim rivets each contain 640 triangles: 7680 of the mechanical mesh’s 12568 triangles. Three thin rings each contain 960 triangles.
decision: Ask Astra for a matched, lower-cost rivet/ring candidate that preserves silhouette and the existing drive hooks.
next: Compare the candidate from the same views before deciding whether to retain it.
evidenceScope: Position-welded triangle connectivity in the current source GLB; not a runtime timing measurement.
performance: 7680 rivet triangles and 2880 ring triangles are candidates for reduction; no frame-time claim.

variantCoverage.note: Source geometry components, before any candidate.

action: Render the canonical package at fitted, end-on, and default chase framing.
observation: The fitted engine retains a circular fan and physical rings, but its dark body loses detail; at standalone chase scale it occupies only a few pixels. All 12 target pieces drew in each captured view.
decision: Preserve the readable silhouette and drive elements while testing small-geometry savings; assess any brightness change on a real assembled craft before changing materials.
next: Inspect a fitted, matched candidate and its in-context appearance.
evidenceScope: Current isolated fleet-look camera and canonical package fetch/hash evidence, not an ordinary actor encounter.
performance: 12 isolated target draw submissions; this count is not a live FPS measurement.

variantCoverage.note: Canonical packaged baseline, with place, side and chase captures.

action: Inspect the current source normal-map pixels and the loader’s image-sharing policy.
observation: The 1024-square source normal map is constant RGBA (128,128,255,255). Other packages share the identical released payload through the image-source dedupe mechanism when their live sources and sampler state permit.
decision: Investigate a block-aligned smaller neutral placeholder across its sharing group rather than changing only one package and assuming a global memory saving.
next: Trace the actual shared group and compare sampling, resident resources and package behavior before any promotion.
evidenceScope: Current source pixels and loader code; shared residency and actual GPU allocation remain unmeasured.
performance: A smaller placeholder may reduce texture work, but a per-engine VRAM or FPS improvement is not established.

variantCoverage.note: Source normal-map dimensions and channel values.

action: Encode a four-pixel version of the existing uniform normal and compare real transcoder output and a scratch package.
observation: All source and candidate mip levels transcode to the same constant RGBA32 pixels and BC3, BC7, ASTC 4x4 and ETC2 blocks. The scratch engine package retains identical decoded geometry, node transforms, material factors and other texture payloads. Eight current modular package sources use the original exact normal payload.
decision: Prepare a normal-only, exact-payload package compilation rule for those sources, retaining the existing material binding and sharing the smaller result.
next: Rebuild the affected packages together and check their actual canonical loaders and unchanged non-normal content before promotion.
evidenceScope: Actual Basis transcoder and scratch compiler evidence; GPU residency and player-route timing have not been measured.
performance: In BC7/BC3 the full original mip chain transcodes to 1398128 bytes versus 48 bytes for the candidate; actual shared GPU residency and frame time remain unmeasured.

variantCoverage.note: Original versus compact normal mip-chain transcoding.
